content: "Young Ahmed" is a 2019 Belgian drama film directed by Jean-Pierre and Luc Dardenne. The film follows a 13-year-old Muslim boy named Ahmed who becomes radicalized and plans a violent attack against his teacher. The movie explores themes of religious extremism, youth radicalization, and personal redemption. It won the Best Director award at the 2019 Cannes Film Festival. The lead role is played by Idir Ben Addi. Beyond these basic details, I want to be clear about the limits of my knowledge and avoid making claims I'm not certain about.
